Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival in Pearland, Texas, I found a two-vehicle collision at an intersection. Driver 1 reported
that they were turning left when Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side. Driver 1 stated that they were in pain from a
wrist injury, and the reported injury is consistent with the mechanics of a side impact of this kind. A Passenger was
also in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the rseponding officers and the statements gathered at the scene confirm that
person was present during the collision. Photographs taken at the scene show damage that largely matches the
described impact, and they confirm several of the reported positions of the vehicles. No independent witnesses were
located. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy for the vehicle involved. No prior damage to the vehicle
was known to either driver or to responding personnel. Both drivers were advised of the reporting process and
provided exchange information before leaving the scene.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
